questions.question: The mathematical misuse is preserved as the joke: complex coordinates are not Euclidean side lengths, and 1²+i²=0 does not produce an actual triangle of zero hypotenuse or area. Decide whether a short explanation is needed after the punchline; the description does not present the erroneous result as fact.

questions.resolution: A note after the punchline gives the identity behind the joke and the ordinary distances between the points of the complex plane. The digest identifies the substitution for side lengths as part of the joke.
